defs.def: a small group of musicians who play popular music together, often with a singer or singers 流行音乐乐队

ex.s: What does Levine want to explain by mentioning the rubber band?
ex.t: Levine提到橡皮筋想要解释什么？

ex.s: I want to focus on my band and have a career in music when I leave school.
ex.t: 我的英语之所以能提高，是因为我的老师和同学。

ex.s: Playing in a band is not a job.
ex.t: 他的信心增强了很多，而且他的成绩也有了提高。

ex.s: And I'm sure playing in a band will help you make lots of new friends at university.
ex.t: 如果发生什么事\/在……的基础上。

ex.s: It also has a voice control setting that enables you to stay hands-free, while its waterproof band is fully adjustable so that it is comfortable to wear.
ex.t: 我是家里唯一受过教育的人，我所有的亲戚都以我为榜样/作为……的典范。

defs.def: a group of musicians who play brass and percussion instruments 管乐队；鼓号乐队
a group of people who do sth together or who have the same ideas 一伙人；一帮人

ex.s: Many famous bands have performed at the festival over the years, and the number of people attending has grown to about 200,000.
ex.t: 我把所有的卡都放在一个篮子里。

defs.def: a thin flat strip or circle of any material that is put around things, for example to hold them together or to make them stronger 带；箍
a strip of colour or material on sth that is different from what is around it 条纹；条饰
a range of radio waves 频带；波段
a range of numbers, ages, prices, etc. within which people or things are counted or measured （数目、年龄、价格等的）范围，段
to put a band of a different colour or material around sth 加彩条（或嵌条等）
to be organized into bands of price, income, etc. （将价格、收入等）划分档次，分等级

ex.s: Many rock bands were able to follow in the footsteps of the Beatles.
ex.t: 然而，他们的歌曲改变了后来几代人的生活。
